Bug_Details: this == null is always false, this != null is always true The boolean expression this != null always returns true and similarly this == null always returns false.
Bug_Explanation: The code incorrectly attempts to compare 'this' reference to null. The expression 'this == null' will always be false because 'this' refers to the current instance of the class, which cannot be null. Similarly, 'this != null' will always be true.
